This role ensures a forward-thinking, agile approach to managing the Bank’s risk
landscape effectively, with a strong focus on anticipating and addressing forward-
looking risks. It requires a strategic thinker with strong mental agility and intellectual
curiosity, capable of understanding and managing all risk types. The role holder is
self-driven, solution-oriented, with a strong drive to own and complete tasks and
projects effectively.

To develop a functional banking management operating model and framework in a
broadly defined business functional strategy; enabling horizontal implementation and
adoption.
